newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu says he will consider meeting Arafat.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu says he will consider meeting Arafat.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Friday he would consider an invitation from Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak to meet Palestinian President Yasser Arafat in Cairo.

"There was an invitation froom President Mubarak. I did not rule it out. I am prepared to consider it. I don't think the meeting will be the stumbling block. It won't be a problem. There will be a meeting. I think the more important thing is to agree on those principles which will guide us, the principles of behaviour, not the arrangments for negotiations or their results," Netanyahu told a news conference.
